12-07-1440 is 1440-07-12 in ISO format.  
27 weeks = 189 days, plus 3 days = 192 days.  
1440-07-12 + 192 days: July has 19 days left (31-12), August 31, September 30, October 31, November 30 → total so far 19+31+30+31+30 = 141 days.  
Remaining 192 - 141 = 51 days into December: December has 31 days, so 1440-12-31 + 20 days = 1441-01-20.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1441-01-20
